title: Food Labeling: Front-of-Package Nutrition Information; Extension of Comment Period
action: Proposed rule; extension of comment period.
abstract: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is extending the comment period for the proposed rule entitled "Food Labeling: Front- of-Package Nutrition Information" that appeared in the Federal Register of January 16, 2025. We are taking this action in response to requests for an extension to allow interested parties additional time to submit comments.
